Various grades are available and are distinguished by appending a number indicative of the appar- ent viscosity in millipascal seconds of a 2% solution measured at 25°. A white, yellowish-white, or greyish-white, powder or gran- ules. Soluble in cold or hot water, forming colloidal solutions; practically insoluble in alcohol, in acetone, and in toluene. A 1% solution in water has a pH of 5.5 to 8.5. USNF 26 (Hydroxyethyl Cellulose). A partially substituted po- ly(hydroxyethyl) ether of cellulose. It is available in several grades, varying in viscosity and degree of substitution, and some grades are modified to improve their dispersion in water. It may contain suitable anticaking agents. A white to light tan, practical- ly odourless, hygroscopic, powder. Soluble in cold or hot water, giving a colloidal solution; practically insoluble in alcohol and in most organic solvents. pH of a 1% solution in water is between 6.0 and 8.5. Uses and Administration Hyetellose is used in pharmaceutical manufacturing as a thicken- er and stabiliser and as a tablet coating and binding agent. It is present in lubricant preparations for dry eye (p.2140), contact lens care (p.1622), and dry mouth (p.2140).
